Andaman and Nicobar.contentHtml:
Andaman and Nicobar Islands Institute of Medical Sciences (ANIIMS)  has released an official notification for the recruitment of 34 Faculty Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official ANIIMS website. The last date to submit the application form is 28-02-2026. In this article, you’ll find the ANIIMS Faculty Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

ANIIMS Recruitment 2026 Faculty Overview

Advertisement
Institute Name Andaman and Nicobar Islands Institute of Medical Sciences (ANIIMS), Sri VijayaPuram
Post Name Professor / Associate Professor / Assistant Professor
Total Vacancy Count 34 Posts
Disciplines Anatomy / Biochemistry / Pharmacology / Community Medicine / General Medicine / Psychiatry / Dermatology / General Surgery / Orthopaedics / Anaesthesiology / Radio-Diagnosis / Paediatrics / Ophthalmology
Qualification MBBS + MD/MS/DNB in relevant discipline (as per NMC regulations 2025)
Upper Age Limit Not Specified (Retired candidates eligible)
Engagement Period 5 Years (extendable by 2 years based on performance)
Monthly Salary Rs. 2,05,000–2,75,000/- + Allowances (post-wise)
Apply Online Start Date 07/02/2026
Soft Copy Last Date 28/02/2026
Hard Copy Last Date 07/03/2026
Apply Mode Offline / Email
Official Website https://andamannicobar.gov.in/
Trending Govt Jobs
  • MMRDA 235 AE, JE and More Posts Online Form 2026
  • RRB 22000 Group D Online form 2026
  • RBI 650 Assistant Online Form 2026
  • Aadhaar Operator Supervisor Online Form 2026
  • Indian Army Agniveer Recruitment Rally Notification 2026

Vacancy Details

Department Professor Associate Professor Assistant Professor
Anatomy 1 0 1
Biochemistry 0 0 1
Pharmacology 0 0 2
Community Medicine 0 1 2 (1+1* Statistician)
General Medicine 0 3 3
Psychiatry 0 1 0
Dermatology 0 1 0
General Surgery 0 2 3
Orthopaedics 1 1 0
Anaesthesiology 1 2 2
Radio-Diagnosis 1 1 1
Paediatrics 0 2 0
Ophthalmology 0 1 0

Eligibility Details

Post Name Qualification
Professor / Associate Professor / Assistant Professor As per NMC Medical Institutions (qualifications of Faculty) regulations, 2025.
MBBS + MD/MS/DNB in relevant subject. Experience after obtaining prescribed qualification until last date of application.

Age Limit

  • Not Specified in the notification
  • Retired Government Employees eligible (remuneration as per OM No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020)
  • For Deputation: As per DoPT rules

Application Fee

Category Fee
For All Candidates Rs. 1000/-

Selection Process

  • Online Interview
  • Document Verification

Important Dates

Notification Release Date 06 February 2026
Opening Date of Rolling Advertisement 07 February 2026
Cut-off Date for Soft Copy 28 February 2026
Last Date for Hard Copy 07 March 2026

How to Apply

  • Send soft copy of application with enclosures in single PDF (max 5 MB) to [email protected] by 28 February 2026
  • Send hard copy with self-attested documents and fee proof by Speed Post/Registered Post/Courier to The Director, ANIIMS, DHS Annexe Building, Atlanta Point, Sri Vijaya Puram-744104 by 07 March 2026
  • Pay fee to Bank Account: State Bank of India, Port Blair Branch, Account Name: ANIIMS Revenue, Account No: 43265885640, IFSC: SBIN0000156
  • Envelope super-scribed with post and department
